description:
We are a team of two building LUNA-LIFE for NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, a browser simulation of a lunar outpost at the Moon’s south pole.

Abdullo Ashurov, team captain, built the project end to end: the simulation engine, the NASA data integration and the interface. His skills are JavaScript, React, Python and AI/ML.

Imomov Rajab Muhammad built the project’s demo presentation page and tested the project: he found bugs and errors and reported them to the captain to fix.
